== Canonicity of The Companion ==

{{Quote|Where it contradicts the information in the series, it should be regarded the same as conflicting information within the books themselves and the conflicting facts and their sources should be noted in the text.}}

Is this really the right approach? It's certainly canon, but a companion book assembled after the death of the author should imho have lesser canonicity than the main series. Perhaps a wording more like:

{{Quote|Where it contradicts the information in the series, information in the series should take precedence (taking into account the reliability of the character, if any, providing the information). The conflict should be noted.}}

[[User:androlf|androlf]]<br />"''[Nynaeve] had better feeling for the man who freely gave one copper from his own purse than for the fellow who wrested a gold crown from someone else’s.''" -[[The Fires of Heaven/Chapter 39]] 13:47, 25 March 2025 (UTC)
